narrative.overview:
After pairs white action surfaces and pink outlines with warm rose conversation surfaces and a detailed adult assistant character. A personal greeting leads into the member's actual progress; compact controls and comfortable conversational text keep the next action easy to find. Korean, Latin text, and numbers share the self-hosted Wanted Sans family.

White is the light canvas and neutral charcoal is the dark canvas. Pink remains the brand signature in both themes; action surfaces follow the theme and action ink stays neutral and readable. Small assistant avatars identify the speaker beside conversational content; human profile photography remains contextual to the person being introduced. The user confirmed this direction on 2026-10-25 and refined conversation warmth and filled tab selection on 2026-10-27.
keyCharacteristics: White light-theme action surfaces, pink outlines, pale selections, and high-contrast neutral ink.
Warm rose assistant speech, a white light canvas, and a charcoal dark canvas.
Detailed adult character avatars beside assistant messages.
A mobile frame with stable chrome and an independently scrolling body.
Brief tactile feedback that respects reduced motion.

rules.name: The Surface and Signature Rule
rules.body: Keep action surfaces and the pink brand signature separate; use neutral high-contrast ink for text, icons, and focus.

rules.name: The UI Family Rule
rules.body: Use Wanted Sans for assistant titles, questions, answers, controls, and numerals; retain the established serif quotation exception.

rules.name: The Stable Chrome Rule
rules.body: Put scrolling in the body and keep action areas in the app frame's flow; preserve the safe-area and keyboard calculations.

dos: Do separate the white/charcoal action surface from the pink brand outline and use semantic theme variables.
Do preserve the supplied detailed adult assistant artwork and the member-to-assistant gender mapping.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, 44px control targets, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep the stable app chrome, safe areas, and keyboard-aware body scrolling.
Do reuse self-hosted Wanted Sans and retain the existing short serif quotation exception.
Do derive status titles and appointment facts from real state and retain existing capability gates.
donts: Don't use pale pink as text, icon, or focus ink; preserve neutral readable ink on warm assistant reading surfaces.
Don't redraw, artistically simplify, or transform the approved detailed v2 character assets.
Don't put an AI portrait into the compact appointment card or impersonate a counterpart's message.
Don't introduce decorative eyebrow labels above already clear titles.
Don't wrap supporting evidence in another card inside a topic card.
Don't treat the legacy generic Card or a removed dock shadow as assistant defaults.
